declarations.name: MASTER_DETAIL_BACK_ATTRIBUTE
declarations.description: Attribute that turns any element inside the detail into a back button.

A list and the record it opens: an inbox and the open message, orders and the order, files and the preview. The
layout follows the element's **own width**, not the window, so it is right inside a dialog, a split panel or a
docs frame:

- **split** (width ≥ `breakpoint`): the master column beside the detail. While `open` is false the detail pane shows
  the `placeholder` slot ("Select a conversation").
- **stack** (below it, `collapse="stack"`, the default): one pane at a time. Opening slides the detail in over the
  master and moves focus into it (to an `autofocus` element, else the pane); the Back bar brings the list back and
  returns focus to where it was.
- **overlay** (below it, `collapse="overlay"`): the detail slides over the master, which stays visible behind a
  backdrop and is inert. Back, Escape or a click on the backdrop closes it.

The element owns no selection: the app shows a record in the `detail` slot and sets `open` (or calls `show()`).
When the user asks to close (the Back bar, an element with the `master-detail-back` attribute, Escape or the
backdrop in overlay) a cancelable `close-request` fires and, unless it is cancelled, `open` turns false. The current
layout is the read-only `layout` property, the `layout-change` event and the `:state(split)`, `:state(stack)` and
`:state(overlay)` custom states, so page CSS can hide an author's own back button in split
(`c2-master-detail:state(split) [master-detail-back] { display: none }`).

Give the host a height (it fills it, and each pane scrolls on its own). The host is an inline-size container, so it
does not grow to fit its content: in a flex or other shrink-to-fit parent give it a width too. Before it is upgraded
or measured — a server-rendered page — a container query on the host lays it out at a fixed 720px breakpoint.
declarations.name: MasterDetail

cssProperties.description: Width of the master column in the split layout.
cssProperties.name: --c2-master-detail__master--width

cssProperties.description: Opaque by default: in the stack and overlay layouts the detail slides over the master.
cssProperties.name: --c2-master-detail__detail--background

cssProperties.description: Line between the panes in the split layout.
cssProperties.name: --c2-master-detail__divider--border

cssProperties.description: Overflow of the master pane and of the detail body.
cssProperties.name: --c2-master-detail__pane--overflow

cssProperties.description: Width of the detail in the overlay layout; never wider than the host.
cssProperties.name: --c2-master-detail__overlay--width

cssProperties.description: Shadow of the detail in the overlay layout.
cssProperties.name: --c2-master-detail__overlay--box-shadow

cssProperties.description: Slide of the detail in the stack and overlay layouts. Reduced motion turns it off.
cssProperties.name: --c2-master-detail--transition-duration

cssProperties.description: `none` removes the bar, for a detail that renders its own `master-detail-back` button.
cssProperties.name: --c2-master-detail__toolbar--display

cssParts.description: Pane wrapping the `master` slot; scrolls its content.
cssParts.name: master

cssParts.description: Pane holding the toolbar and the `detail` slot; a `region` named by `detail-label`, a `dialog` in the overlay layout.
cssParts.name: detail

cssParts.description: Scrolling box wrapping the `detail` slot, under the toolbar.
cssParts.name: body

cssParts.description: Bar at the top of the detail in the stack and overlay layouts, wrapping the Back button and the `toolbar` slot.
cssParts.name: toolbar

cssParts.description: Region of the detail column wrapping the `placeholder` slot.
cssParts.name: placeholder

cssParts.description: Shade over the master while the detail is open in the overlay layout.
cssParts.name: backdrop

slots.description: The list: a `c2-list`, `c2-table`, `c2-tree`, anything. Fills the master pane, which scrolls.
slots.name: master

slots.description: The open record. Shown in the detail pane while `open` is true.
slots.name: detail

slots.description: Shown in the detail pane in the split layout while nothing is open; hidden in the other two.
slots.name: placeholder

slots.description: Extra content after the Back button in the stack and overlay layouts (a title, actions).
slots.name: toolbar

slots.description: Replaces the chevron of the Back button. Mirrored in a right-to-left context.
slots.name: back-icon

members.name: open
members.description: The detail is showing. The app sets it when the user picks a record; the element clears it on Back, Escape (overlay) and the backdrop.

members.name: breakpoint
members.description: Width of the element, in pixels, from which master and detail sit side by side.

members.name: collapse
members.description: Layout below `breakpoint`: `stack` shows one pane at a time, `overlay` slides the detail over the master.

members.name: detailLabel
members.description: Accessible name of the detail pane. Defaults to "Details" in the nearest `lang`.

members.name: backLabel
members.description: Text of the built-in Back button. Defaults to "Back" in the nearest `lang`.

members.name: layout
members.description:
The layout in use: `split`, `stack` or `overlay`. Before the element has been measured (not yet connected, or
rendered on a server) it is computed from `breakpoint` against the current width.

members.name: show
members.description: Opens the detail, as setting `open` does.

members.name: close
members.description: Closes the detail without a `close-request`, as clearing `open` does. Focus returns to the master in the stack and overlay layouts.

members.name: hasOpened
members.description: True when `open` changed after the first render: the initial value must not move focus.

members.name: focusedInShadow
members.description: The element of this shadow tree holding focus (the Back button, a pane), or `null` when it is elsewhere.

members.name: focusedInRoot
members.description: The focused element as seen from the tree this element lives in: a slotted child's descendant, or a host above.

members.name: slotOf
members.description: The slot of the child of this element that holds `element`, or `undefined` when it is not inside one.

events.name: layout-change
events.description: Fired when the element's width crosses `breakpoint` or `collapse` changes, after the first measurement. Does not bubble.

Fired when the user asks to close the open detail, before `open` turns false. Cancelable: `preventDefault()` keeps it open (unsaved changes). Not fired by `close()` or by setting `open`. Does not bubble.
events.name: close-request
